steps.en: Install the gateway on one host — native systemd or Docker Compose
steps.zh: 在台主机上装好网关：原生 systemd 或 Docker Compose

steps.en: In the admin console, add a provider with its upstream key and import its models
steps.zh: 在管理控制台里添加 Provider，填上游 API key，导入它的模型

steps.en: Create a project and issue a project-scoped API key with quota and allowlist
steps.zh: 建一个项目，发一把带配额和模型白名单的项目级 API key

steps.en: Point your app at the gateway and call it with that key
steps.zh: 把应用指到网关，用这把 key 发起调用

steps.en: Validates the project key; enforces quota, RPM/TPM and allowlist admission
steps.zh: 校验项目 key，执行配额、RPM/TPM 和白名单准入

steps.en: Selects a route by priority, weight and health, failing over when needed
steps.zh: 按优先级、权重和健康度选路由，必要时自动故障转移

steps.en: Forwards through the provider adapter and streams the response back
steps.zh: 经 Provider 适配器转发上游，把响应流回给应用

steps.en: Logs tokens and cost attributed to user, project and team
steps.zh: 记录 token 与费用，归属到用户、项目和团队

value.en: Apps stop carrying raw provider keys — every call is policy-checked and attributable to a project's bill
value.zh: 应用不再持有厂商原始 key——每次调用都过策略检查，都能归属到项目和账单

sources: https://github.com/astaxie/TokenHub README Quick Start (curl install.sh / sudo bash /tmp/tokenhub-install.sh install; cp deploy/.env.example deploy/.env; ./deploy/install.sh; console :3000, API :8080, /healthz)
